role: raw time-resolved peripheral physiology alignment and analysis analysis specification

scientific_scope.primary_question: Can raw event-aligned GSR/PPG dynamics reveal reproducible autonomic temporal structure or brain-body coupling that was not captured by the prespecified 40-feature trial-level physiology representation?
scientific_scope.previous_trial_summary_result_immutable: M1-M3 from discovery_multimodal_inference remain unsupported and are not reinterpreted by opening a distinct raw-dynamic representation.

split_lockbox.Discovery: timing audit and, only after later specifications, development/inference permitted
split_lockbox.Validation: raw physiology values and timing columns remain unopened until a prespecified Discovery dynamic support gate
split_lockbox.Confirmation: raw physiology values and timing columns remain unopened until one-shot Validation transfer passes

epoch_contract.source: raw_eeg_epoch_folds prespecified EEG epoch manifest; windows are copied, never reselected from physiology

families.definition: source-supported endpoint - 25 s to endpoint - 5 s

candidate_clock_interpretations_in_fixed: outcome_model_integrity: csv_time minus JSON StartTime, if finite/monotonic and scale matches sidecar sampling frequency
C2: csv_time minus first finite csv_time, if finite/monotonic and scale matches sidecar sampling frequency
C3: row-index divided by sidecar SamplingFrequency, timing-only fallback

primary_feasibility_gate.if_failed: stop the joint raw-dynamic branch; do not auto-switch to a favourable single modality or alternate windows

future_sequence_if_raw_dynamic_physio_ti: raw_dynamic_physio_preprocessing_specification: specification amplitude preprocessing, artifact/QC, resampling and dynamic representation before amplitude access
raw_dynamic_physio_synthesis: execute Discovery raw GSR/PPG preprocessing and build event-aligned autonomic trajectories
raw_dynamic_physio_sync_correction: prespecified outcome-free autonomic structure and EEG-autonomic coupling inference in Discovery
exact_physio_eeg_sync_recovery+: only if the pre-specified Discovery support+robustness gate passes, one-shot Validation then Confirmation transfer
